sensor: 1/3" Panasonic MN34229 CMOS (1080p, Wide Dynamic Range)

storage.notes: Ships with a 16GB microSD card installed. Also supports FTP upload and the optional INSTAR Cloud.

features: first INSTAR camera with the 1080p chipset (Panasonic MN34229)
integrated PIR heat sensor (120 deg, ~5m) plus software motion detection

frigate.notes: INSTAR HD/Full HD generation uses a simple numbered RTSP path (/11 main, /12/13 sub) rather than the '/livestream/NN' pattern of the newer 2K+/4K line. Exact substream numbering not independently confirmed; ONVIF support was not documented for this legacy model (RTSP confirmed).

home_assistant.notes: ONVIF unconfirmed for this legacy model; the generic RTSP/MJPEG camera integration is a safer starting point. MQTT is a documented alternative INSTAR has supported since this camera's era.

blue_iris.notes: Not independently confirmed for this specific model.
